serra-da-mantiqueira-ridge.title: Serra da Mantiqueira Ridge
serra-da-mantiqueira-ridge.slogan: The ridge road between São Paulo and Minas: coffee on the slopes, cloud in the mornings and very little traffic once you are up.

waypoints.name: Santo Antônio do Pinhal
waypoints.advice: Santo Antônio do Pinhal is where the day begins. Next is Maria da Fé, climbing 170 m.

waypoints.name: Maria da Fé
waypoints.advice: Maria da Fé comes up 48 km in. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Itanhandu, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Itanhandu
waypoints.advice: At least 110 km in you reach Itanhandu. You lose 390 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Passa Quatro.

waypoints.name: Passa Quatro
waypoints.advice: Passa Quatro closes the day.

sections.advice: Santo Antônio do Pinhal → Maria da Fé, 84 km. Part of Serra da Mantiqueira Ridge.
Maria da Fé → Itanhandu, 59 km, dropping about 390 m. Part of Serra da Mantiqueira Ridge.
Itanhandu → Passa Quatro, 15 km. Part of Serra da Mantiqueira Ridge.

serra-da-mantiqueira-ridge.provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Maria da Fé → Itanhandu
scenicChapters.narrative: 55 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Serra da Mantiqueira Ridge
scenicChapters.narrative: For 13 km this is Serra da Mantiqueira Ridge, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

serra-da-mantiqueira-ridge.story: A one-way ride of 145 km, Campos do Jordão to Passa Quatro - roughly 2 h 47 in the saddle. On the way it passes Maria da Fé and Itanhandu. The highest point is 1,270 m. The line favours views over speed.

core-ulagan-plateau-and-katu-yaryk.title: Ulagan Plateau and Katu-Yaryk
core-ulagan-plateau-and-katu-yaryk.slogan: A difficult signature route to one of Altai's most dramatic descents.
core-ulagan-plateau-and-katu-yaryk.story: A difficult signature route to one of Altai's most dramatic descents. The road: Ulagan and Katu-Yaryk roads. Distance and riding time are estimates from the checkpoints until the road is measured on this page.
